name: Coding Agent
description: External mini-swe-agent-backed A2A Coding Agent. Read-only skills inspect the target repository and return structured findings; write-capable skills require PI confirmation. The deployed agent runs mini-swe-agent's DefaultAgent in YOLO mode and should be operated inside a sandbox.

skills.name: Repository Inspection
skills.description: Run mini-swe-agent against the repository and return a structured summary plus a recommended next task. Read-only.
examples: Review the current repo and suggest what coding task should be done next.

skills.name: Bug Fix Plan
skills.description: Use mini-swe-agent to investigate a failing test and prepare a focused patch plan. Repository writes require PI confirmation.
examples: Fix the failing test in this repo.

skills.name: PR Review
skills.description: Use mini-swe-agent to inspect recent branch changes (git diff/log) and emit structured review findings. Read-only.

skills.name: Test Generation Plan
skills.description: Use mini-swe-agent to identify uncovered behaviour and propose tests. Writing tests requires PI confirmation.

skills.name: Documentation Draft
skills.description: Use mini-swe-agent to inspect the target module and draft documentation guidance without writing files. Read-only.
